name: Harlan Needs a Resupply
objectiveText: Go to the Canal Tailor Shop and bring Rema Schneider the Cloth Request from Harlan Bagley . Cloth Request (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body: She is near the canal banks in a shop, located at 49,55 ~ Hope this helps :)

replies: The Co-ords given are correct for those of you who don't have a Co-ord add on. [b]The Quest Giver[/b] is in the [b]Lionheart Armory[/b] in The Trade District. It is [i]next to[/i] [b]Weller's Arsenal[/b].

comments.body: WHere is Harlan Bagley? The quest giver?
Were is the canal tayor shop, to compltere this quest?
replies: She's just north of the trade district, to the right of the gate, facing the canal.

comments.body:
Location is 49,55 just to make life easy...
